review_scope: Bounded source-code and JSON identity review of the isolated complete BOOT/C/TX/WP joint model; no geometry or native execution.

findings.classification: Reuse guard required; historical pre-BOOT diagnostic is valid within its recorded scope.
findings.evidence: The constructor imports composite_native11_C_TX_WP and copies that earlier BASE. It predates the completed BOOT overlay. The newer inspect_C_remaining_cuts11.py imports composite_native11_complete_BOOT.
findings.impact: Reusing the historical constructor as a current complete-BOOT constructor could overstate available routing space or construct copper conflicting with the now-held BOOT paths.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the old constructor and receipt. Create a new versioned constructor bound to the current complete model and give it a new output receipt.

findings.classification: Reporting error in reviewed snapshot; does not change geometry.
findings.evidence: The provenance label uses UUID membership in g.by. Transformed U15, C13, C11, R42 and C31 pads retain native UUIDs despite changed physical records.
findings.impact: Conditional moved-pad obstacles can be mislabeled as retained accepted native11 copper, confusing which source or peer transaction owns a blocker.
findings.recommendation: Compare current physical records against the native record with net_code excluded, or use an explicit transformed-pad UUID set. Record the corrected classifier in a new or explicitly revised diagnostic.
findings.correction_status_at_review: Parent reported that a worker would correct attribution after the running diagnostic; correction was not revalidated by this review.

findings.classification: Latent accessor hazard; no active affected consumer found in the bounded review.
findings.evidence: The overlay removes all R43/R44 pads from BASE while one_pad falls back to inherited accessors that still return their prior front-layer divider records.
findings.current_consumers: Current divider constructors use explicit newly transformed p43/p44 records. Legacy one_pad('R43.1') consumers import composite_native11_divider_joint, in which those pads still exist.
findings.impact: A future terminal query through the inherited accessor could target copper absent from the selected joint model.
findings.recommendation: Add a new versioned BASE-derived accessor wrapper. Resolve all physical records for a key from the selected object list, reject absent keys and reject duplicate keys in one_pad. Permit an explicit trial-object list for newly placed pads. Do not mutate archived composites or receipts.

findings.evidence: Binding records native/context/geometry-helper hashes and overlays add receipt hashes. It does not bind imported composite branch_objects, graph_native11 or route_native11 implementation hashes. The constructor records its own script hash but not those imported implementations.
findings.impact: Source equality alone cannot distinguish a diagnostic produced before versus after the foreign-channel alias correction, or other imported semantic changes.
findings.recommendation: Include imported model/helper hashes in new diagnostic receipts or a versioned source manifest. Preserve historical binding objects and mark their historical scope explicitly.

passed_obligations.method: Pure JSON record reconstruction following the declared pad replacement sequence; no geometry imports or contact calculations.
passed_obligations.NC_land_handling: Declared NC lands are upstream copper. They do not replace the actual bonded U15.1/U15.2 obligations or imply a component-internal conductive connection.

BOOT_duplicate_pad_check.status: Existing source and receipt inspected; seal not rerun.

passed_obligations.known_foreign_channel_alias_bug: Already corrected in the reviewed composite_native11_C_TX_WP helper; not reported as a new finding.

limitations: No geometry graphs, routing, native export, refill, DRC, schematic parity, finite-entry or electrical checks were executed.
No canonical board, archived composite, or historical receipt was edited by this review.
Reviewed hashes identify the snapshot read during the review; concurrent later worker changes are not certified by this artifact.
Passed identity obligations do not prove current routability, final actual-I/O topology, full-width pad entry, saved-plane reference coverage or electrical qualification.
The source-model release of R43/R44 remains conditional on explicit replacement placement and complete divider reconstruction.
No change to the accepted board or its 11-open status is claimed.
